APPROACH: Host RPC вызывает `musebridge accounts usage --json`; server сливает аккаунт по id через `collectMergedUsage` (один запрос с первой машины, где он signed in). UI — `navPanel` path `muse` с `''` / `machines` / `add`; settings сводятся к счётчику и `toPluginPanel("muse")`.
LESSON: Pin version in files outside owns_paths (here `tests/account-slots-sync.test.mjs` still expects `0.3.8`) will fail a full `npm test` after a version bump the writer cannot patch.

dispatchContext.rulesText:
- In verification scripts and tests that create temp dirs, use /tmp explicitly (mktemp -d /tmp/x.XXXXXX, or TMPDIR=/tmp): the writer sandbox denies mkdtemp in the system TMPDIR under /var/folders. Keep PM-written check scripts in /tmp/<name>/ (the guard blocks .mjs under .agents/).
- In a folder without git (live-folder mode), never put a task's expected_outputs or owns_paths under .bb/ (chat folders): the live snapshot skips .bb, so a file written there is never counted as produced and the task blocks as missing expected_outputs. Put task deliverables in a project folder such as docs/ or reports/.
- Generate site designs without waiting for the owner's approval; keep iterating and testing until the result is a genuinely modern, colorful, attractive site, not a bland one.
- When generating a site screen by screen, pass the previous screen to the generator and tell it which next screen of the same site it is producing, so the screens read as one coherent site.
- Правя тестовый файл из owns_paths, меняй только ожидаемые значения внутри существующих строгих assert (deepEqual/equal) и добавляй новые проверки рядом — не удаляй строки assert и не ослабляй строгую проверку до assert.ok/includes/truthiness; перед ответом перечитай свой diff по тестам и верни всё, что стало слабее: test_fit помечает это как сломанную проверку, и попытки сгорают до лимита.

{"summary":"This task overhauls the Muse connector UI in BB (task 'muse-ui-panel') to decompose the current single-page settings view into a structured multi-page navigation panel alongside a minimal settings summary.

Currently, app.tsx only registers a settingsSection ('muse-accounts') that bundles runtime status, Chrome/bridge/agent discovery, problem alerts, inline account creation, and host-specific account lists into a single stack of host cards. The plan (.agents/plans/muse-ui-panel.md) specifies introducing a dedicated panel registered via app.slots.navPanel({ id, title, icon, path: 'muse', component }) accessible at route '/plugins/muse/muse/<subPath>' with inner routing handled by useBbNavigate().toPluginPanel('muse', { subPath }).

The panel consists of three dedicated sub-pages:
1. Accounts (subPath: ''): Presents a deduplicated list of Muse accounts merged across all hosts. Each card displays the account label, status pill, plan name, weekly limit progress bar, reset schedule label, extra tokens line, parallel chat limit, and machine chips indicating which hosts hold the account and their sign-in status. Actions include Check, Copy to all machines, Remove (prompting for profile deletion on confirm), and Refresh limits. If usage fails to load, the card displays 'Limit unavailable: <reason>'.
2. Machines (subPath: 'machines'): Displays one card per BB machine detailing online state, connector runtime version/installation button, Chrome detection, bridge and agent status, and compact account rows with busy slots (e.g., '2/10'), linking to the Accounts page without inline account actions.
3. Add account (subPath: 'add'): Provides a host selector (disabling machines lacking Chrome), label input, Add button, 3-step instructions, status/result notice, and a link to return to Accounts.

The existing settingsSection in app.tsx is stripped of all host and account cards, retaining only a concise summary ('2 accounts · 3 machines') and an 'Open Muse panel' button linking to the navPanel via toPluginPanel('muse').

Supporting RPC contracts must be implemented in host.ts and server.ts: host.ts exposes 'usage' executing 'musebridge accounts usage --json', while server.ts exposes 'usage' to query usage once per unique account from the first connected signed-in host in parallel, merging host associations and capturing errors with null usage on failure. Visual styling must conform to Pokecut tokens in app.css without hardcoded hex colors, and all UI text must be localized in en and ru in i18n.ts. Finally, tests/ui-panel.test.mjs must be written, version 0.3.9 updated across package.json, package-lock.json, and version.ts, and all tests and typechecks verified
